'''''Leach''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] belonging to the [[Pakuuni Pirates]]. It was defending a pirate outpost along with ''[[Clavier]]'' and ''[[Grapler]]''. ''Leach'' was destroyed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ace [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] along with the other corvettes and the entire outpost.
